finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can provide a malicious file path that includes shell metacharacters or control operators.
finding.assumptions: The filePath is derived from untrusted input and the environment where this code runs allows shell metacharacters to be interpreted.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The code does not use the filePath in a way that would allow shell metacharacters to be interpreted. The filePath is passed directly to std::ifstream::open, which does not execute the file path as a shell command. Additionally, there are no checks or indications that the filePath is derived from untrusted input.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can provide a malicious regex pattern that includes shell metacharacters or control operators.
finding.assumptions: The query is derived from untrusted input and the environment where this code runs allows shell metacharacters to be interpreted.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The code does not involve any system calls or shell command execution. The regex pattern is used solely for pattern matching within the file content and does not interact with the operating system shell. Therefore, there is no risk of OS command injection.
